verdict.note: Verdicts are read from paired CIs on identical test points. A CI on the mean paired difference that excludes zero counts as a significant win or loss; everything else is reported as no reliable difference. Rank correlations are computed only where a split has at least 5 test perturbations. Any readout listed under unreliable_readouts is one where the latent oracle did not rank in the top two, meaning that readout cannot score reversal faithfully and its ranking numbers should not be used as evidence.
